assistants.label: Chat Agent
assistants.description: Fast data analyst for ad-hoc business questions backed by ClickHouse analytics. Supports charts, data visualization, and quick data insights.
exampleQuestions: покажи формулу реструктуризации в коде репозитории gitlab?
покажи статистику по ai_savings для MMRU по 335 спринту на графиках по департментам

assistants.label: MT Chat Agent
assistants.description: Fast knowledge retriever for quick factual lookups and Q&A from your knowledge base.

assistants.label: Story Chat Agent
assistants.description: Business Analysis Assistant for creating high-quality Jira user stories. Transforms stakeholder requirements into well-structured stories with acceptance criteria.

assistants.label: BA Research Agent
assistants.description: Researches and analyzes Jira stories to create comprehensive BA specifications and requirement documents. Reviews pre-development requirements for completeness, consistency, and scope correctness.

assistants.label: BA Task Chat Agent
assistants.description: BA task chat agent for creating and updating Jira tasks and Confluence pages.

assistants.label: Codebase Q&A Agent (for business users)
assistants.description: Business-facing Q&A assistant for your GitLab codebase. Helps non-developers understand what features, integrations, and functionality exist in the code.

assistants.label: AI History Review Agent
assistants.description: Reviews one completed AI-assisted task: retrieves the executor's AI session history from GitLab, cross-checks Jira estimates/time/AI-savings and the shipped diff, and produces a lead/architect review report with mentor coaching examples.
exampleQuestions: Do a history review for task MMRU-1234
Do a history review for task MMRU-1234 and publish the report to Confluence

Invoke sprint-review for DEP_DEV team sprint 341 in project MMRU
PROJECT: MMRU
SPRINT_NUM: 341
DISCIPLINE: DEP_DEV
Task: sprint × discipline AI-review roll-up for the team lead and mentor.

assistants.label: AI Task Estimation Agent
assistants.description: Estimates a Jira ticket BEFORE development starts: builds the scope from the ticket's requirements corpus, decomposes it into work items per department rubric (backend / frontend), sizes each against the real codebase, and returns ASOE (AI Self Original Estimate) — hours with a band and a confidence — plus a detailed execution plan. Writes ASOE to its Jira field and posts the plan as a Jira comment.
exampleQuestions: Estimate task MMRU-1234 — both backend and frontend, and post the plan to the ticket

assistants.label: QA Research Agent
assistants.description: Generates complete QA packages from Jira tickets: requirements analysis, gap detection, functional checklists, manual test cases, and effort estimation.
exampleQuestions: Для Jira <KEY>=MMRU-XXXX: собрать требования через spec-researcher (Jira links + Confluence + attachments).  Далее запустить qa-requirements-researcher. ВАЖНО: текст description для qa-requirements-researcher должен состоять РОВНО из двух частей:  byte-for-byte output spec-researcher (без каких-либо добавлений/удалений/правок), затем на новой строке ровно фраза: Сформируй итоговую QA документацию на русском языке. Запрещено добавлять любые другие слова/заголовки/ограничения/пояснения/разделители (включая “ONLY”, “START/END”, “markdown”, “не запрашивай контекст” и т.п.).  Результат qa-requirements-researcher сохранить byte-for-byte в файл: <Date>_<KEY>_QA_checklist.md.

assistants.label: DE Chat Agent
assistants.description: Analitics and data engineering assistant base on project specific clickhouse database.

assistants.label: Product Alert RCA Agent
assistants.description: Root-cause analysis for hourly AR/IR conversion alerts (MMRU): validates the alert, localizes the broken funnel step in ClickHouse, then correlates with deploys, newly appeared component errors and per-component metrics, and returns ranked causes with a check-this-first list.
exampleQuestions: ar_new_1h ALERT 03:00-04:00 MSK, conversion 41.2%, target 58.7% — найди причину
ir_old_1h просел в этот час — это выдача или артефакт данных?
Какой шаг воронки сломался за последние 3 часа и что менялось?

assistants.label: Spec Research Agent
assistants.description: Technical Business Analyst for investigating Jira issues, building retrieval evidence bundles, and producing normalized requirements corpora for development teams.

assistants.label: SD Chat Agent
assistants.description: Jira Service Management assistant for triaging, classifying, and responding to service desk tickets. Helps structure and route support requests efficiently.

assistants.label: SD Incident Agent
assistants.description: Jira Service Management incident-intake assistant for guided ticket creation.

assistants.label: Meeting Summary Agent
assistants.description: Extracts key decisions, action items, and discussion points from meeting transcripts or notes. Produces structured summaries ready to share with stakeholders.
exampleQuestions: Summarize this meeting transcript and extract all action items
What decisions were made in this planning session? [paste transcript]
Create a stakeholder-ready summary of this sprint retrospective

assistants.label: MNA Doc Generator Agent
assistants.description: Generates M&A documentation packages from retrieved tool inputs. Produces structured acquisition and due diligence documents from provided data sources.

assistants.label: Legal Document Assistant Agent
assistants.description: Drafts, reviews, and answers questions about legal documents and contracts. Helps identify key clauses, risks, and obligations in legal texts.

assistants.label: Pure Local Chat Agent
assistants.description: Local-only chat with no external data retrieval. Use for privacy-sensitive conversations or offline reasoning without any knowledge base access.
